These are elite mobs: grouping up is encouraged, look for people to do it with. Chef Nek'rosh is a level 32 elite: most classes solo it at level 34, but you may need help. Skip it if you are alone: the route has you grind the XP back. Careful: Shadowcasters stand on either side of him, and at least one is linked to him, so it joins when he is pulled. Non-elite centurions and captains are spread around his ring of tents.
Récupérez 1 × Tête de Nek'rosh sur Chef Nek'rosh
